title: Crispy Air Fryer Tempeh
summary: A batch of crispy air fryer tempeh is one of my favorite ways to add texture and plant-based protein to any meal. I use tempeh, coconut amino, spices, and maple syrup to infuse these lightly crisp bit…
ingredients: 1 tbsp Coconut Aminos (or low-sodium soy sauce )
steps: Add all ingredients, except for the tempeh, into a mixing bowl and mix well.
Gently fold the diced tempeh into the prepared sauce until combined. Marinate the tempeh for 10 minutes.
While the tempeh marinates: preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees F / 190 C.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with non-stick cooking spray or brush with olive oil. Arrange the marinated diced tempeh in an even layer, ensuring the pieces don’t touch.
Cook the tempeh for 8-10 minutes, or until lightly golden and crispy.
Remove the tempeh from the air fryer and use it in your favorite dishes or enjoy it as a snack.
